content: Cleaning reports: The next step was to extract the text content from these reports. Due to the significant time expense of manually re-typing all the pathology reports, we developed a new strategy to prepare our dataset. We applied an Optical Character Recognition (OCR) software to convert the PDF reports to text files. Then, we manually inspected all generated text files to fix any grammar/spelling issues and irrelevant characters as an artefact produced by the OCR system.
